sources.size_estimate: ~10-20 MB (PDFs downloaded) — potential 1-3GB with full note sets
sources.notes: Tier-1 sources confirmed: Coleman QFT 253a (arXiv:1110.5013, 335pp), Quantum Many-Body Theory (arXiv:2507.09229, 504pp), David Tong QFT (qft.pdf, ~230pp + 14 video lectures), Srednicki UCSB QFT DRAFT (616pp). README and SOURCES.md are in this folder. Scope: undergraduate through PhD — linear algebra to QFT, many-body, quantum info, condensed matter. See individual source entries below for per-paper details.

Sidney Coleman's Physics 253a — Quantum Field Theory. Harvard 1986-87. 28 lectures, 335 pages. Typeset by Yuan-Sen Ting + Bryan Gin-ge Chen. arXiv:1110.5013v5 (Feb 2013). Gold-standard QFT reference. Downloaded as HTML abstract page — PDF at https://arxiv.org/pdf/1110.5013. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1110.5013.

Quantum Many-Body Theory lecture notes. arXiv:2507.09229. 504 pages. 2025 submission. SHA256: 4C33F2A82EF888C169D60D35DC284F661A370F2CE62620A4C920268D589EA377 (from BULK_DOWNLOAD_LOG.md). One of the highest-volume single documents in the Math genre.

sources.format: HTML page downloaded (links to chapter PDFs)
sources.notes: David Tong QFT lecture notes (Cambridge + Perimeter Institute). 6 chapters: Classical Field Theory, Canonical Quantization, Interacting Fields, Dirac Equation, Quantizing Dirac, QED. 4 problem sheets. 14 PIRSA video lectures. Only the index HTML was downloaded — full PDF at /pdfs/teaching/quantum-field-theory/qft.pdf is separate. Status: partial (need qft.pdf). SHA256 of index: 98EBF0B80F8DF59C7EFC1942FDBE9D22131C751139B637EEB272F45ECB3DCBF8.

Mark Srednicki QFT draft (UCSB). 616 pages. Free from publisher for personal use. Referenced in BALANCED_CORPUS_500MB_LOG and bulk_500mb_manifest.txt. Covers QFT from introductory to advanced — spin-0, spin-1/2, spin-1 fields, renormalization, path integrals. Complements Coleman and Tong well.
